title: org.openvpi.otter.inference.Align Level 1 exports
description: Properties declared by a forced alignment contribution: the audio format that a host must prepare, the languages and non-speech classes that the module distinguishes, the silence label, and the supported knobs. The interface and level define the syntax, independent of the variant.

sampleRate.description: Input sample rate in hertz. The host resamples the audio to this rate; the module never resamples.

channelCount.description: Input channel count. The module averages input with more channels down to this count and rejects input with fewer channels.

maxSegmentDuration.description: Maximum duration of the audio accepted by one execution, in seconds. No limit applies if absent. The limit is mandatory: the host slices the audio so that no segment exceeds it.

languages.description: The languages this module aligns. Each entry specifies an ISO 639-3 code, the scheme of its phonemes (a wolf scheme name), the form of its lyrics, and the phonemes a result can contain. Each language and scheme pair appears at most once. Absent or empty indicates that the module does not distinguish languages.

defaultLanguage.description: The language used by an execution that specifies none. Required if languages is not empty, and must be one of the listed languages.

nonSpeechPhonemes.description: Labels of the non-speech sounds that the module detects independently of the lyrics. Absent or empty indicates that the module detects no non-speech sounds.

defaultNonSpeechPhonemes.description: The non-speech labels detected by an execution that specifies none. Must be a subset of nonSpeechPhonemes.

silenceLabel.description: Label of a word that represents silence. If absent, the module does not report silence as a word.

knobs.description: The knobs this module supports. The module ignores a caller-supplied value for a knob that is absent here.

scheme.description: The scheme of the phonemes, such as pinyin or arpabet.

lyrics.description: scheme: lyrics are syllables written in the scheme, as produced by a wolf G2P of the same language and scheme. text: lyrics are ordinary words, which the module converts internally.

phonemes.description: All phoneme labels that a result in this language can contain, excluding the silence label and the non-speech labels.
